hash_scope: Trusted overlay file bytes before per-build ID injection; final snapshot hashes must bind the injected header.

injection.default: all-zero; verification must reject an all-zero build ID
injection.runtime_source: compiled static const bytes; never copied from a request

protocol.crc: CRC32/IEEE (zlib), request CRC at 20 over [0,20), response CRC at 96 over [0,96)

scheduling.ordering: between complete GSFR frames, before the next READY frame; never changes tx while tx_busy
scheduling.reset: drop queued/in-flight query state and pre-reset RX bytes
scheduling.retry: same or new nonce accepted after previous response TX completion has been consumed by StorageTask
scheduling.response_deadline_note: A request behind an active GSFR can wait up to the existing 3000 ms frame timeout; host should allow retry/time budget.
